description: This file defines the `soapval` class, which is used for creating serializable abstractions of native PHP types for SOAP web services. It includes properties for element name, type, value, namespaces, and attributes, along with methods for serialization and decoding.

classes.name: soapval
classes.description: Represents a SOAP value with associated metadata such as name, type, namespaces, attributes, and methods to serialize and decode the value.

methods.name: soapval
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a soapval object with optional name, type, value, namespaces, and attributes.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the soapval object into an XML string based on the provided use mode.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the soapval object into its PHP native value.
